verdict_reason: The rebase fix re-creates the pre-Design-Release-2.1 reason-for-import card and wires it back in, reverting main's Main import reason card and orphaning main-import-reason.js.

todos.issue: The rebase fix commit 714a8f5 re-creates this pre-Design-Release-2.1 card, which main's EUDPA-696 (#484, inc-102/inc-274) had renamed to main-import-reason.js, and repoints sections/about-consignment.js:5 at it. The review page loses DR 2.1 behaviour EUDPA-776 does not ask to change: the card is titled 'Reason for import' (copy.cards.reasonForImport) not 'Main import reason', it sits under a 'Main import reason' group heading again, and a transit lists Destination country before Port of exit (exitRows line 23) where main lists Port of exit then Destination country (main-import-reason.js transitExitRows). main-import-reason.js is left orphaned beside it and no longer even resolves its imports (exitsAsTransit and changeAction are gone from applicability.js and rows/change-link.js).
todos.fix: Must: the PR head's review page renders the Main import reason card exactly as origin/main does, from one card module, with no pre-rebase copy left in the tree. One way: delete reason-for-import.js (and the other restored pre-2.1 modules from 714a8f5: import-details.js, additional-animal-details.js, species/species-card-*.js, units-for-commodity-line.js, movement/transit-countries.js), take about-consignment.js, applicability.js, change-link.js and copy.en/cy.js from origin/main, and re-apply only the contact-address removal on top.
